about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the webfetch guess of the failure class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real 403/404 error line with the host. good does the fetch-github-first read of the same case: it prints the repos call, listing, ref and contents evidence with the check lines. Edit this file, then run: python skills/fetch-github-first/scripts/pairs_to_md.py

fixture.repo/OWNER.txt:
owner record
default branch main
licence MIT

pairs.bad: throw 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404) GET https://api.github.com/repos/owner/name (guessed webfetch, repos call never made)'
pairs.good: 'repos call checked exists default branch licence PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (404 GET https://github.com/owner/name/blob/main/guide.md) (guessed fetch, no repos call)'
pairs.good: 'repos call contents exact path pinned ref PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/name/main/guide.md: 404 Not Found (guessed raw URL for file)'
pairs.good: 'contents call pinned ref file lines PASS no raw fetch'

pairs.bad: throw 'GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/name/v9/guide.md: 404 Not Found (assumed ref v9, default branch never read)'
pairs.good: 'repos record default branch resolve ref read PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'gh: API rate limit exceeded (HTTP 403) GET https://api.github.com/repos/owner/name (too many webfetch calls, no backoff)'
pairs.good: 'repos call once backoff retry contents call PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (404 GET https://github.com/owner/name/blob/main/guuide.md) (guessed path, directory listing never read)'
pairs.good: 'directory listing exact path contents PASS read file next'

pairs.bad: throw 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404) GET https://api.github.com/repos/owner/name (full read guessed, no repos call)'
pairs.good: 'repos call default branch list directory contents exact path PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (404 GET https://github.com/owner/name) (docs summary guessed, exists never proved)'
pairs.good: 'exists proved fallback to contents files PASS docs read'

pairs.bad: throw 'GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/name/v9/helper.ps1: 404 Not Found (pinned release ref never resolved)'
pairs.good: 'pinned ref resolved from record contents quoted lines PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (404 GET https://github.com/owner/name/blob/main/helper.ps1) (helper reused, licence never noted)'
pairs.good: 'repos call licence MIT helper lines reused PASS evidence shown'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (404 GET https://github.com/owner/name/blob/main/retryy.ps1) (retry helper guessed, never searched)'
pairs.good: 'search first repos contents exact path read lines PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404) GET https://api.github.com/repos/owner/name (report lists no record, no ref, no results)'
pairs.good: 'record listed ref resolved contents results unverified stated PASS'
